acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Great Cats family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Panther, T3, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Sightline Specialist archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two normal construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Long low black cat with faint rosettes, reflective eyes, flexible shoulders, and an uninterrupted predatory silhouette.
Signature mechanic: Unbroken Gaze: the Panther marks a line between its visible eyes and prey, then strikes the first other target to cross it.
battlefieldDuty: Move through connected dark cover and isolate one target by threatening allies who cross its marked line.
constructionDimensions: Fur, rosettes, whiskers, claws, teeth, breath, scars, and disturbed foliage remain natural and species-specific.
Concealment relies on posture, cover, shadow, elevation, and stillness rather than supernatural invisibility.
counterplay: Flood the line with a deliberate feint or attack the still eye position before moving the isolated target. Affinity signal: Tail stop, ear flattening, visible eye line, open saber pin, or traced territory edge remains readable before commitment.
forbiddenTreatments: Humanoid posture, clothing, saddles, or armor
identityInvariants: Every form retains a four-legged feline body, flexible spine, retractile claws, whiskered muzzle, mobile ears, and expressive tail.
Species variation remains feline and is communicated by coat pattern, limb proportion, mane, canine length, and hunting posture rather than equipment.
Eye line, tail stillness, shoulder compression, cover disturbance, and landing posture preserve readable attack direction.
telegraph: Shoulder rosettes vanish sequentially into cover while the reflective eyes remain fixed and visible.
